name: Cube On in Richardson 2025

venue.name: The University of Texas at Dallas
venue.details: Saturday: Student Union - Galaxy Rooms, Sunday: SCI - 2.210

information:
The main competition day will take place on Saturday, November 15th, in the Galaxy Rooms of the UTD Student Union. Sunday afternoon will feature blindfolded events and will take place in the Sciences Building (SCI Room 2.210). 

On Sunday Morning, we will have a separate Fewest Moves competition, [Texas FMC Championship 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TexasFMCChampionship2025). You can find more information on the [Texas FMC Championship 2025 tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeOninRichardson2025#64575-texas-fmc-championship-2025).

The University of Texas at Dallas and the Comet Cubing Club will not take custodial responsibility of minors while participating in Cube On in Richardson 2025. Custodial responsibility will remain with teachers K-12, parents, legal guardians, and chaperones.

This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
